children.role_hint: Clocked dynamic comparator core containing the differential input pair, tail switch, precharge devices, and cross-coupled regenerative latch. Vin and Vip are sampled and converted into differential internal decision nodes Vx and Vy, while VP and VQ are intermediate dynamic sensing nodes. No explicit DC bias-generation devices are present; operation is controlled by clk.

MN9 VQ clk vdd vdd pmos w=W6 l=L6 nf=1 m=1

children.role_hint: Capacitive storage and loading network on the dynamic internal comparator nodes VP, VQ, Vx, and Vy. These capacitors set transient charge-storage behavior and affect regeneration speed and dynamic node settling.

C1 VQ vss cap C1
